payload.claim: The `(preserves)` tag test only checks the standalone `_criteria_lines(acceptance)` call, never the tag's position inside the actual filled prompt, and the test's own `acceptance` fixture happens to put its one `preserves=True` criterion last. Replacing `criterion.preserves` with `criterion is acceptance[-1]` on this line would still produce exactly one `(preserves)` tag, on the same last line, so `test_each_end_review_prompt_is_its_own_file_filled_with_the_layers_fields` stays green while a spec whose preserving criterion is not the last one would be mislabeled in the Spec lens's prompt. No test uses more than two criteria or puts `preserves` on a non-last entry, so the tag's correlation with the actual flag is unverified.
